defects.justification: scrypt with n=2**14 is below the OWASP minimum cost (N=2^17, r=8, p=1) for password storage; borderline, but I would require raising the work factor (also on line 53) before production.

No request body size limit anywhere (FastAPI/uvicorn have none by default); the pydantic max_length checks only run after the whole JSON body has been read and parsed, so a large body from an unauthenticated client can exhaust memory.
fastapi, uvicorn, httpx and pytest are completely unpinned, so installs are non-reproducible and can silently pull breaking or malicious versions.
